events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released in 1971, making 2026 its 55th anniversary year.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since its release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album still resonates. Its message of peace and unity feels as vital today as it did in '71.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo work, a true icon of British music.

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary Year
events.blurb: The first Apple iPod was announced in October 2001, revolutionising portable music and paving the way for how we listen to tracks today, making 2026 its 25th anniversary year.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years since Apple first introduced the iPod! Who remembers getting their first one and filling it with all their favourite tunes? A game-changer for music on the go.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas and introduced the world to 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, born on this day in 1940, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate and adoration. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who died in 1991.

angles.name: A True Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the music world lost an irreplaceable talent. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since 'Rubber Soul' changed the game! The Beatles' iconic album showcased a new depth and maturity, influencing countless artists. Still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Forever Missed
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message continue to resonate profoundly.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, born on this day in 1947, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary life and boundless creativity of David Bowie. A true innovator, forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, born on this day in 1935, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Long Live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King still reigns supreme!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's most influential guitarists. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! Here's to more 'One Step Beyond' moments.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that smooth, soulful voice that defined the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The beloved country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend whose talent, heart, and sparkle shine brighter than ever.
